newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - First Bank cut to hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - First Bank cut to hold.

text.p: -- Chicago Corp said it reduced its rating on First Bank System Inc to a hold from buy based solely on valuation.
-- The stock has met and exceeded the $65 a share price target and now trades at 14.1 times the 1996 estimate of $4.75 a share, Chicago Corp said in a report dated September 20.
-- First Bank System shares on Monday traded down 1/4 at 66-3/8.
-- "The company's fundamentals remain very strong and our estimates remain unchanged," Chicago Corp said.
